ingredients.name: sturdy salad greens, such as romaine, iceberg, escarole or kale
cooked grains, like quinoa, farro, bulgur wheat or barley
roasted vegetables, like potatoes, sweet potatoes or winter squash
thinly sliced raw vegetables, like bell peppers, celery, carrots, fennel, mushrooms, onions, radishes, snap or snow peas, summer squash or tomatoes
salad dressing, like yogurt, tahini or a vinaigrette, plus more to taste
sliced or chopped nuts, like almonds, walnuts, pecans or hazelnuts, plus more to taste

steps.text: Place greens in bottom of serving bowl. Add grains in an even layer over greens. Repeat with the roasted vegetables, then the raw vegetables.
Top with dressing, and toss gently. Fan out avocado on top on one side of bowl.
Place hard-boiled egg pieces on the side opposite the avocado. Top with chives and nuts. Serve with whole-grain bread.
